items.title: Critical Media and Communication Studies Today. A Conversation
items.venue: tripleC Communication Capitalism & Critique Open Access Journal for a Global Sustainable Information Society
items.summary: This article records a conversation between Dwayne Winseck and a co-author, first posted on their two blogs, about the current state of critical media and communication studies. They cover topics such as the work of Dallas Smythe, how to study Google, the role of Karl Marx and ideology critique in the political economy of the media, and neoliberalism and capitalist crisis as context for the field. It matters because it sets out how scholars in this area see the field's main questions and points of disagreement, in an open access format that invited reader comments.
